notes.title: Milfvania Ep. 2 - Story update (2 missions, 2 new scenes)
notes.notes:
I'm excited to announce a thrilling new update for my game, packed with fresh content and exciting features! Part of the promised content updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43769236/a860d10f27d3e6be1d4d86674a3706eec7c24018.png[/img]

[b]New Missions[/b]
[list]
[*]Mission 1: Fulfill your promise to Larisa by working to free Tanya from jail. But it won’t be simple—this mission will test your strategy and decision-making skills as you navigate a series of perilous choices.
[*]Mission 2: Use Tanya to catch a notorious pimp. Tread carefully—one wrong move could jeopardize your plans and put everyone at risk.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43769236/04e25e5344c8fb7d6ddfc3564c3593b9e492ba8a.png[/img]

[b]Two New Animated Scenes[/b]
Experience stunning, fully animated sequences featuring Tanya and Alina as they take the spotlight in dramatic and emotionally charged moments.

[b]Achievements Galore[/b]
Unlock 7 brand-new achievements as you progress, offering additional challenges and rewards for completing specific milestones in the story.

[b]Interactive Scene Selector[/b]
Take control of your experience with a new interactive scene selector, allowing you to play your own key moments.

notes.title: Update in the works (new mission/content)
notes.notes:
I'm currently working on adding a new mission to Milfvania Ep. 2. This is part of my promised upgrades to the game, which include better graphics, improved game mechanics, enhanced dialogue, and a more engaging story (hopefully).

It will feature two animated scenes with Alina and Tanya. These scenes will occur just after the jail scene with Larisa, where you promised to testify about the counterfeit money and to get her mother (Tanya) out of jail.

It will contain a nice mission you will solve. Luckily, Alina will join and you can do it together. 
Estimated release: July.

[/list]

notes.title: Doing the last touches & future Ep. 3
notes.notes:
I'm currently preparing Ep. 2 to be approved by Steam.

I delayed the release date slightly, so that I have enough time to fix bugs and check it some more. Compared to Ep. 1 it has more minigames so more logic that could go wrong.

And last thing, not many of you know that Milfvania Ep. 1 was done a long time ago, and Ep. 2 development started in late 2022. Hence, the not so good graphics of Ep 1. and hopefully you will see the improvement Ep. 2. 

I also noticed that although feedback was positive a lot of people complained about the length of the episode. [b]That's why, Ep. 3 is going to be the final one, as large as originally intended. [/b]

Due to the fact it takes a lot of time to develop even a short game, when it has enough content I will release it as early, with further updates to be done.
